title: StatusBuilder fields are all pub with no non_exhaustive
description: mastodon_api.rs:181-205 StatusBuilder has 24 pub fields, no #[non_exhaustive], and no Default impl. Adding any field is a semver-breaking change because all 3 downstream servers construct it with struct literal syntax. Either add #[non_exhaustive] + a constructor/Default, or switch to actual builder pattern (methods returning &mut Self). The 'Builder' name is misleading since it has no builder methods.
close_reason: Fixed: Default derive added to StatusBuilder. #[non_exhaustive] removed per project policy — these types are intentionally extensible.
